purpose: Generate and rank non-branded keyword hypotheses from permitted demand sources. This is a research tool, never a publishing tool or a ranking guarantee.

seedClusters.audienceJob: make procedural variation reviewable and repeatable
create, assess, and integrate generated game assets
keep asset-generation workflows local and controllable
turn stable parameters into useful worldbuilding variation

guardrails: Do not scrape Google, Reddit, gated tools, or search-result pages.
Do not represent a generated phrase as a keyword with demand until a permitted source supplies evidence.
Do not use private Forge code, assets, paths, benchmarks, or product details as a seed source.
Do not create, draft, modify, or publish public content from this job.
Only human review can turn an opportunity into a research brief.
